open_issues: WDialog (src/Wakeel.Design) has no way to switch off its confirm button and Wakeel.Design is outside this package's allowed paths, so the switched-off look of the typed-confirmation gate is carried by a class on the dialog surface (w-dialog--confirm-locked, set by AdminConfirmDialog) plus one rule in the new unscoped src/Wakeel.Admin.UI/wwwroot/css/admin.css. The guard itself is in the component (CanConfirm blocks HandleConfirm). A later design-consistency package should add a real ConfirmDisabled/Disabled to WDialog's confirm button and delete that rule.

The high finding asked for a new WFilePicker component in Wakeel.Design; that project is outside this package's allowed paths, so A04's three choosers are built from the existing WButton over an out-of-sight InputFile (opened by wakeelAdmin.openFilePicker). If the shared component is wanted, it belongs to whoever owns Wakeel.Design.

Two shared-table defects are worked around per page and belong in Wakeel.Design: WTable forces white-space: nowrap on th, and its .w-table-scroll box counts hidden WTooltip bubbles (laid out while invisible) as scrollable content, so any short table paints scroll bars. A06/A07 override both; other screens that use WTable will hit the same thing.

Preview deviations accepted under the supervisor ruling that the specification wins: A06's preview has a «الحاسوب» column and «إضافة مكتب»/«طباعة رمز الجرد» page actions (offices are made in A05 and no machine name is in the data model); A07's preview has a dedicated «إلغاء جهاز» card and a second «مفاتيح الأجهزة» table (the host revokes from the row action and shows the signed revocation list instead); A05's preview lays six fields three to a row and adds a «التحقق من صحة الهيكل» panel that B1-A05 does not ask for.
A05's tree is still the hand-rolled AdminStructureNode and the tree pane is still a hand-made card — left as the reserved deviation for the shared-WTree design-consistency package, as ruled.
notes:
BUILD/TESTS — all four commands exactly as given: three builds 0 Warning(s) 0 Error(s) (TreatWarningsAsErrors clean), `dotnet test tests/Wakeel.Admin.Tests --no-build` Failed 0, Passed 162, Total 162 (156 before, +6 new).

WHAT CHANGED PER FINDING

HIGH (hand-rolled chips/pills/button): `.a04-mark`/`--known|--unknown|--missing` deleted; the nine placeholder marks are now WChip (Success known, Warning unknown, Neutral missing) in a plain `<ul>` whose CSS only does flex/gap — AdminAr.Organisation.LetterTemplate.MarkLabel(name, count) writes the mark and its «×٢» on one chip. `.a04-file`/`.a04-file-button` deleted; A04's three choosers (logo, report template, letter template) are WButton(Secondary, upload) with tooltips, over an `<InputFile id=…>` kept out of the reading order in `.a04-file-hidden` and opened by the new `wakeelAdmin.openFilePicker(id)`. `.a06-code`/`.a06-code-label` deleted; the inventory code is a WChip(Neutral, no dot) beside the two state chips, so the office header is one row of chips. `.a07-key`/`.a07-key-version` deleted; the key line is a WKvRow («إصدار المفتاح» → «الإصدار ١» + the Success chip). `.a07-revoked` and its `li` rule deleted; each shut-out device is a WKvRow keyed by the device name with the day in a WChip(Danger). No page stylesheet defines a surface, border, radius or semantic colour any more.

MEDIUM (A07/A06 tables): the `::deep th/td` rule ties WTable's own `.w-table ::deep th` on weight and is read first, so the selector now names `.w-table` and wins; cells wrap and A07's side rail went 360px → 320px. That alone still left a bar, because WTable's scroll box counts the hidden WTooltip bubbles of the row buttons as content — a table of at most nine devices never needs to scroll, so both pages set `.w-table-scroll { overflow: visible; max-height: none }`. Measured on the running host after the change: A06 scrollWidth 959 = clientWidth 959, scrollHeight = clientHeight; A07 no scroll box at all, table fills its card in both themes.

MEDIUM (invisible typed-confirmation gate): AdminConfirmDialog passes `Class="w-dialog--confirm-locked"` while «تأكيد» does not match; the new unscoped src/Wakeel.Admin.UI/wwwroot/css/admin.css (linked from index.html) switches the confirm button off exactly as WButton does (opacity .55, cursor not-allowed, pointer-events none), and a reason line sits under the field — «يُفتَّح الزر بعد كتابة كلمة «تأكيد» مطابقة.» which becomes «الزر مفتوح الآن.» on a match. Verified on the host: locked → pointerEvents none, opacity .55; after typing → auto/1. bUnit test added.

MEDIUM (false seed wording): A07 now picks between three fates — SeedsHeld, SeedsDestroyed («أُتلفت بذرة المفتاح عند إلغاء الجهاز», new) when `!SeedsHeld && ExportedAt is null`, SeedsGone otherwise. Reproduced on the host: device ٢ revoked before any export now reads «أُتلفت…». Test added.

MEDIUM (square crop missing): new src/Wakeel.Admin/Services/AdminWindowsImageSquareCrop.cs (BitmapDecoder → CroppedBitmap for the largest square at the given focus → TransformedBitmap to maxSide → PngBitmapEncoder, 40 MPx cap, no new package) registered in App.xaml.cs before AddWakeelAdmin so it beats the TryAdd fallback. Verified on the host: a 600×300 PNG came back 300×300, the «موضع القص المربّع» slider rendered and re-cropped live at focus 0, and «تعذّر القصّ» was absent.

MEDIUM (mixed figures): Counting.Count draws its figure with AdminAr.Digits in both the 3–10 and 11+ branches, and the dashboard's revoked-device alert uses AdminAr.Devices.DeviceName instead of an InvariantCulture int. RevokedDevices and OfOffices went the same way. On the host A03 now reads «٣ أجهزة / جهازان نشطان · جهاز مُلغى», «٨ تغييرات بانتظار التوزيع», «من ١», «(الجهاز ٢)».

LOWS: «جهازان نشطة» → new Counting.ActiveDevices with a matching adjective for every shape (0/1/2/3–10/11+), test added. Report template is now checked as a Word package (LetterTemplateInspector.IsWordDocument opens the zip and requires word/document.xml) instead of by its name — refused live on the host with «هذا الملف ليس ملف Word بصيغة docx.» and nothing stored. LetterTemplateInspector.MaxBytes is enforced at the top of Inspect. ReadDeviceRow drops the COALESCE and returns null when the LEFT JOIN finds no account, so a half-made device can never be handed a manager certificate. A failed accounts INSERT returns the new DeviceRefusal.CouldNotSave with its own wording instead of «رقم الجهاز مأخوذ». A revoked row's two switched-off buttons carry «أُلغي هذا الجهاز، ولا إجراء بعد الإلغاء» (test added). A06 closes with a WBanner («إضافة جهاز إلى هذا المكتب» + how the setup file reaches the computer) and an «آخر تحديث لحالة الأجهزة» line. A05's «المكتب والجرد» is folded into the detail card as a WSectionHeader section. A01's footer hint becomes «بعد الإنشاء تُعرض ورقة الاسترداد مرة واحدة، فجهّز الطابعة.» once the four fields hold up (confirmed live).

SIDE-BY-SIDE (host at 1366×768, light and dark, each beside design/exports/preview/light/A)
A04 vs «A04 — المؤسسة والهوية»: same two-column grid, اسم الهيئة | شعار الهيئة on the first row, الدورة المالية | صيغة ترقيم الملفات on the second, قالب التقرير الشهري full width under them; upload button on the far side of the logo frame; amber numbering caution in the card. → fixed: the picker is now a real button, the marks are chips. Deviations accepted: the preview's page actions read «استعادة الافتراضي» where the host has «التراجع عن التعديلات» (same act, clearer wording); the preview says «SVG أو PNG» where the spec says PNG/JPG ≤ 2MB — spec wins.
A05 vs «A05 — الهيكلية»: preview has tree | one detail card with the actions at its foot. → fixed: the host is one card now (detail + «المكتب والجرد» as a section, 14px above its header). Deviations recorded: fields sit two to a row instead of three (all four are full-width controls at this width); no «التحقق من صحة الهيكل» panel (not in B1-A05); the tree is the reserved hand-rolled one — indentation still reads flat.
A06 vs «A06 — المكاتب والأجهزة»: same anatomy — offices rail with search and counts, office header with path and the inventory-code chip on the far side, devices section with its count, table, information banner, «آخر تحديث» foot. → fixed: banner and foot line added, code chip matched, no scroll bars. Deviations recorded: no «الحاسوب» column (no machine name in the data model) and the host splits «الدور» into its own column with an actions column; page actions are «تحديث» rather than «إضافة مكتب»/«طباعة رمز الجرد» (offices are made in A05).
A07 vs «A07 — الحسابات والمفاتيح»: preview shows the danger dialog open with «يُفتَّح الزر بعد تطابق العبارة.» → fixed and now rendered, button visibly off. Key card, revocation, accounts table all present. Deviations recorded: the host has one «قائمة الإلغاء» card where the preview has a dedicated «إلغاء جهاز» form, and no second «مفاتيح الأجهزة» table (the certificate column carries that fact).
A03: re-checked only for the two wording fixes.

HOST — four launches (each after a rebuild) on port 9334 at 1366×768 with a temporary --data-folder; /json/version answered each time; the whole package was driven end to end (A01 → recovery sheet → A03 → A05 → A06 → A07 → A04). Log after all four: four «Wakeel admin host starting up» lines, no WRN/ERR/FTL. Process killed each time and the endpoint confirmed silent; no Wakeel.Admin process is left running.
